Joins all Montgomery tracts to 2025 code-violation counts and CDC adult high-blood-pressure prevalence with total population, computes the per-1,000-residents violation rate, and returns the correlation and paired-tract count over non-null pairs with nulls preserved.
sql: WITH violations AS (SELECT geoid AS v_geoid, SUM(n) AS violation_count FROM fw_pg.tract_counts WHERE run_id = 'r_20261027_9b67fc' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all' GROUP BY geoid), health AS (SELECT tractfips AS h_geoid, CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_blood_pressure_prevalence, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation FROM session.fw_9b67fc_m2_cdc) SELECT t.name AS tract_name, COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count, h.totalpopulation AS totalpopulation, CASE WHEN h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation > 0 THEN (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000 END AS code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents, h.high_blood_pressure_prevalence, CORR(CASE WHEN h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation > 0 THEN (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000 END, h.high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS rate_prevalence_correlation, COUNT(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation > 0 THEN (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000 END) IS NOT NULL AND h.high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) OVER () AS paired_tracts, t.geoid FROM fw_pg.tracts t LEFT JOIN violations v ON t.geoid = v.v_geoid LEFT JOIN health h ON t.geoid = h.h_geoid WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
